values.en: Let $\gamma$ be a regular curve parametrized by arc length with $\gamma''\neq 0$, with Frenet frame $\{\boldsymbol{t},\boldsymbol{n},\boldsymbol{b}\}$, curvature $\kappa$ and torsion $\tau$. Then $\boldsymbol{t}'=\kappa\boldsymbol{n}$, $\boldsymbol{n}'=-\kappa\boldsymbol{t}-\tau\boldsymbol{b}$ and $\boldsymbol{b}'=\tau\boldsymbol{n}$; pointwise, $\boldsymbol{t}'(s)=\kappa(s)\boldsymbol{n}(s)$, $\boldsymbol{n}'(s)=-\kappa(s)\boldsymbol{t}(s)-\tau(s)\boldsymbol{b}(s)$ and $\boldsymbol{b}'(s)=\tau(s)\boldsymbol{n}(s)$. The derivative of every frame vector is thus again expressed in the frame itself, with a skew-symmetric coefficient matrix whose entries are $\kappa$ and $\tau$; these two scalar functions determine the frame up to a rigid motion.
values.zh-CN: 设 $\gamma$ 是满足 $\gamma''\neq 0$ 的以弧长为参数的正则曲线，其 Frenet 标架为 $\{\boldsymbol{t},\boldsymbol{n},\boldsymbol{b}\}$，曲率为 $\kappa$，挠率为 $\tau$。则 $\boldsymbol{t}'=\kappa\boldsymbol{n}$、$\boldsymbol{n}'=-\kappa\boldsymbol{t}-\tau\boldsymbol{b}$、$\boldsymbol{b}'=\tau\boldsymbol{n}$；点态地写作 $\boldsymbol{t}'(s)=\kappa(s)\boldsymbol{n}(s)$、$\boldsymbol{n}'(s)=-\kappa(s)\boldsymbol{t}(s)-\tau(s)\boldsymbol{b}(s)$、$\boldsymbol{b}'(s)=\tau(s)\boldsymbol{n}(s)$。于是标架向量的导数都可用标架自身线性表示，其系数矩阵是反对称的，元素恰为 $\kappa$ 与 $\tau$；这两个标量函数在刚体运动的意义下决定了标架。
